description: Roads Register is a dataset listed in Ballarat open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Ballarat. This dataset describes the register of public roads to record the details of the public roads, and ancillary areas, for which the City of Ballarat is responsible under the requirements of the Road Management Act (2004). Coverage: Ballarat, Victoria. The portal files it under Transport, Roads & Planning. Its keywords are roads. The portal shows 9,749 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 3 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/au/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ballarat-vic-gov-au-portal.
